verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents an API reference covering projects, experiments, datasets, logs, prompts and scorers, plus per-language SDK API references for Python, Go and Java. Code examples appear only in the GitHub SDK README. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: interactive API explorer, runnable in-browser examples, published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of reference quality.
